description: NaBe₂Tl₂F₈Tl crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one Tl cluster and one NaBe₂Tl₂F₈ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. In the Tl cluster, Tl is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaBe₂Tl₂F₈ sheet, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.39 Å. Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 17°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.59 Å) Be-F bond lengths. Tl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one F atom. The Tl-F bond length is 2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Be and one Tl atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one Be atom.
